Title: Marketing Program Manager
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# POSITION OVERVIEW
OpenEye, The Cloud Video Platform, an innovator in the design and development of cloud-centric software solutions for commercial video management systems, is seeking a Marketing Program Manager to join our growing Marketing team in the Liberty Lake, WA office.
We are looking for an experienced marketing professional to lead OpenEye's program sponsorships, content syndication campaigns, and third-party partnerships to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth for OpenEye.
In addition to managing marketing programs, this role will provide hands-on support for ongoing website management in WordPress, helping ensure our website content, campaign landing pages, and digital experiences remain current, accurate, and aligned with marketing initiatives.
This creative and team-oriented person will be a key member of OpenEye's marketing department and will play a leading role in implementing our marketing initiatives through our media sponsorship and website efforts.
This individual contributor role reports directly to the Digital Marketing Manager.
# RESPONSIBILITIES
- Develop and execute strategy for marketing programs, including content syndication programs and sponsored webinars to support OpenEye’s Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) generation and revenue growth goals, including identification of new sponsorship vendors and evaluation of program ROI.
- Collaborate with the Marketing, Product, and Sales teams to develop marketing messaging, collateral and digital experiences as needed to support campaign development.
- Work with the event and content teams to identify areas of media sponsorship synergy at our OpenEye sponsored events to help elevate our brand awareness and event presence.
- Manage the budget tied to OpenEye’s program sponsorships, as well as manage relationships with sponsorship vendors, and partner associations.
- Support ongoing website management in WordPress, including updating and publishing content, building or modifying campaign landing pages, coordinating site enhancements, and ensuring website content aligns with current marketing programs and branding guidelines.
- Partner with the Digital Marketing team to help maintain website accuracy, performance, and usability, and assist with troubleshooting or coordinating updates as needed.
- Other duties as assigned.
# REQUIREMENTS
- Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business Administration or related field.
- 3-5 years of related marketing experience.
- 10% travel may be required.
- Demonstrated experience managing digital campaigns, vendor relations and associated budgets.
- Experience with helping manage websites and using WordPress.
- Experience in working with Salesforce and/Pardot desired though not required.
- Detail oriented and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, from development to completion.
- Excellent time management and organizational skills required.
- Self-motivated with ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Creativity and adaptability required.
Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.
# The Perks!
- Employees are eligible to purchase company stock at a discounted rate
- Collaborative, fun, creative culture where idea sharing is encouraged
- Casual dress (Jeans are welcome!)
- Medical, dental, vision & prescription benefits starting day 1! Generous medical plan subsidy and health savings account option with company contribution helps keep your costs low.
- Up to $5,000 annual company match for 401k
- Company paid short-term/long-term disability, AD&D and life insurance
- Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) to get reimbursed for your well-being needs
- Paid maternity and paternity leave
- Pet Insurance
- Free annual membership to Care.com
- Free access to the Headspace app for you and up to five friends and family members.
- 15 Days of Paid Vacation accrued per year (increases after year 3)
- Paid Sick/Wellness time is accrued at a rate of 1 hour for every 35 hours worked, except where local laws are more generous
- Educational Assistance Program covering non-degree support, undergraduate and graduate degrees
- Employee Equipment Program – Free Alarm.com system for your home!
# OpenEye is an Equal Opportunity Employer
In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information").
The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information.
We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies.
# Notice To Third Party Agencies
Alarm.com understands the value of professional recruiting services.
However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position.
In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you.
If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.

> This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role.
> The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

> $25—$35 USD

Title: Group Product Manager Quantum Networking
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

> # About IonQ
> IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security.
> IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense.
> In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.
> Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
> Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space.
> IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.
Location: This role is based at our Bothell, WA office, with the option to work a few days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 20%, domestic and international.
Job ID: 1630
# The Role
We are looking for a Group Product Manager, Quantum Networking and Devices to join our Networking and Security technical team.
As Group Product Manager, you'll be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ on its journey to build advanced quantum networking technologies to solve the world's most complex problems.
In this role, you will be responsible for owning the full-stack product strategy for IonQ's quantum networking systems — from the photonic and atomic devices that generate and store entanglement to the control plane that orchestrates entanglement distribution across a real, multi-node network.
The ideal candidate is a rigorous systems thinker who is equally comfortable debating photonics with research scientists and APIs with developers, and who thrives at the frontier where physics and product meet.
# Responsibilities
- Define and own the multi-year product roadmap for quantum networking and devices, prioritizing investments across entanglement generation, the integration of quantum repeaters, and the control plane against measurable improvements in fidelity, rate, range, and time-to-market.
- Drive business growth for the quantum networking product line by identifying market opportunities, aligning product strategy with customer and application needs, supporting sales engagements, and contributing to revenue-generating product launches and partnerships.
- Lead cross-functional execution across hardware, software, research, and go-to-market teams, translating physics-layer capabilities into product specs, milestones, and customer-ready offerings on a committed cadence.
- Shape IonQ's quantum networking cloud and SaaS surface by defining how customers discover, schedule, and consume networking primitives via APIs, and partnering with engineering to ship developer-facing experiences that drive adoption.
- Serve as the product authority on quantum networking with customers and partners — including national labs, government sponsors, hyperscalers, and enterprise design partners — turning their input into validated requirements and committed roadmap.
- Contribute to functional planning and budgeting, owning the portion of the product budget required to execute the networking roadmap and presenting progress to executives, the company, and external audiences.
- Set the methods, frameworks, and trade-off models that the broader product organization adopts for evaluating networking and devices investments, raising the bar for technical product rigor across IonQ.
# Requirements
- 8+ years of professional experience in product management for technical, hardware-adjacent, or research-driven products, with experience shipping at the intersection of physical devices and software, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Bachelor's degree in physics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Working fluency in quantum optics and/or photonics — sufficient to engage substantively with engineers and researchers on ion–photon interfaces, entanglement protocols, photonic component trade-offs, and detector physics.
- Strong grounding in classical networking — protocols, architecture, control planes, time synchronization, and how distributed systems handle latency, scheduling, and reliability.
- Demonstrated SaaS product experience — you've shipped cloud or API products at scale and understand what makes a backend technology feel like a product to a developer.
- Track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs without formal authority and earning the trust of senior engineering and research counterparts.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical trade-offs into clear narratives for executives, customers, and external audiences.
# Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in physics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
- Hands-on product or engineering experience with quantum repeaters, quantum memories, or QKD systems.
- Background working with trapped-ion, neutral-atom, or other matter-qubit modalities.
- Experience working with US government and defense customers (NIST, IARPA, DOE, DoD).
- Active involvement in relevant standards bodies (IETF QIRG, ETSI ISG QKD, etc.).
The approximate base salary range for this position is $145,920 - $191,047.
The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

Title: Risk Data Analyst Integrated Risk Management
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

We are looking for a Risk Data Analyst.
The Integrated Risk Management team is managing risk profile of the company.
Identifying financial risks and management advisory on their mitigation.
Providing service of developing forecasting and risk models for the Company's financial portfolio and implementation in the Company's processes.
# Challenges that await you
- Take ownership of credit risk management as a key domain, oversee the management of credit, liquidity, FX, and strategic (business plan) risks, acting as the 2nd line of defense in the organization’s risk management structure
- Accurately calculate the unit economics of credit products, with a deep understanding of credit risk drivers, to deliver essential insights for strategic decision-making
- Develop, implement, and automate a comprehensive risk management framework, integrating it effectively into organizational documents and processes
- Analyze the methodology of Mexican (CNBV, Banxico) and global (Basel, IFRS) frameworks to apply best practices to PLATA’s processes
- Evaluate internal and external data to identify potential threats to the PLATA loan portfolio, construct econometric models to predict portfolio dynamics, and detect unusual behavior
- Create effective data visualizations and presentations to communicate findings and drive necessary actions among managers
# What makes you a great fit
- A minimum of 3 years’ experience in risk and data analysis, preferably within credit organizations or consulting; experience in integrated risk management is a plus
- Bachelor’s degree in STEM, finance, or economics; a Master’s degree is highly advantageous
- Exceptional analytical and quantitative abilities, with expertise in statistical analysis, data modeling, and extracting insights from complex data sets
- Proficiency in SQL and Python (/R) is essential, complemented by knowledge of Tableau (/Apache Superset) and Excel
- A self-starter with the capability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced, evolving environment
- Outstanding presentation and communication skills, adept at conveying intricate data concepts to non-technical audiences
- B1 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team
# Our ways of working
- Innovative Spirit: a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions
- Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication
- Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community
- Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together
- High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances
# Our benefits
- Relocation support to one of our hubs — Mexico, Cyprus, Spain, Serbia — with assistance for the employee and their family
- Flexible work from one of our offices or remote
- Healthcare Coverage
- Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications
- Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursements
- Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave

Title: Product Manager II Spacecraft Software Platform
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# About the role
Muon Space is hiring a Product Manager to own the software that runs on our spacecraft.
Reporting to a Director of Product Management, you will own the end-to-end capabilities and roadmap for the flight software platform and onboard compute, so that our spacecraft meet customer mission needs.
This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office four days per week.
# Responsibilities
# Flight Platform and Onboard Compute
- Own the product roadmaps for the flight software platform and onboard compute.
- Define and prioritize features that improve product quality, schedule adherence, or customer value.
- Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), drive alignment, and follow through reliably.
- Partner with the Director of Product Management to develop the strategy for the product areas including build/buy decisions.
- Conduct customer interviews, gather feedback on product–market fit, and translate insights into product artifacts and roadmap decisions.
# Cross-functional Coordination
- Partner closely with engineering teams across flight software, hardware, and mission systems to define features and roadmap.
- Partner with other software product managers on roadmaps where capabilities intersect.
- Coordinate with the Director of PM — Federal on defense-aligned product needs and inputs to roadmap.
- Collaborate with the VP of Product and the broader PM team on strategic roadmap decisions and prioritization trade-offs.
# Required Qualifications
- 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated success owning software products in technically complex environments.
- Experience in flight software, embedded systems, robotics, or adjacent deep-tech software domains.
- Experience working cross-functionally with multiple engineering teams at once, rather than a single team.
- Demonstrated success in uncertain environments with incomplete requirements and shifting schedules.
- Proven track record delivering major features or programs spanning multiple months of effort.
- History of independent execution and implementation across multiple concurrent workstreams.
- Strong fluency working with engineering peers and leadership; able to influence cross-organizational technical investment without direct authority.
- Demonstrated ability to translate customer mission needs into detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria across software systems.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
# Nice-to-have Skills
- Active U.S. Government security clearance.
- Familiarity with flight software, embedded systems, or real-time operating systems.
- Familiarity with onboard or edge compute and the trade-offs between processing on orbit and on the ground.
- Familiarity with building or operating software for the space environment.
- Prior experience in startup or high-growth technology environments.
# Salary
The salary range for this role is $190,000-$210,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package.
Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.
> # About Muon Space
> Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data.
> Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance.
> Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale.
> From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.
> # Taking Care of Our Team
> At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package.
> In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance.
> We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.
> Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too.
> Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce.
> We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
> We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants.
> We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application!
> In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Title: DSP Engineer Werkstudent
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

> # Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
> At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life.
> We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software.
> Like our products, we work better together.
> We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
> Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful.
> Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change.
> Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
# Your Impact
This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe.
As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild.
You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.
# What You'll Do
Location: Onsite at our Kassel, Germany office, with flexible hours around your studies
Reports to: Team Lead
- Help prototype, implement, and test DSP algorithms in Python and C++.
- Analyze recorded RF / I/Q captures and help characterize drone and controller signals.
- Build and improve scripts and tooling for signal analysis, data handling, and visualization.
- Run experiments and document results to support detection and classification work.
# What You Bring
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Coursework or project experience in DSP fundamentals (e.g., sampling, filtering, FFT/spectral analysis, modulation).
- Programming experience in Python and/or C++.
- Genuine curiosity about RF / wireless and signal processing, and an eagerness to learn on real data.
- Good communication skills in English; German is a plus.

> If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways.
> You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

- Experience using quantitative analysis to diagnose product problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide product decisions.
- Experience partnering with Engineering and cross-functional teams to deliver products, systems, or platform capabilities.

- Experience building or scaling a platform used by internal product or engineering teams.
- Experience increasing leverage from existing systems to drive business impact.
- Experience in consumer finance, fintech, or another regulated industry.
- Experience working with Machine Learning.
- Experience balancing near-term customer or business outcomes with longer-term platform investment.
- Familiarity with using GenAI thoughtfully to improve product development, decision-making, or customer experiences.
